description: This header file declares internal API functions for the Slap Bmc2 Command Object within the Service Logic Aggregation Plane (SLAP) implementation. It includes prototypes for functions related to object state management, collection handling, and parameter access, specific to the Bmc2 command object.

methods.name: SlapBmc2ComoReset
methods.description: Resets the state of the Bmc2 Command Object.

methods.name: SlapBmc2ComoGetCount
methods.description: Returns the count of certain items within the Bmc2 Command Object.

methods.name: SlapBmc2ComoGetCommandName
methods.description: Retrieves the command name associated with the Bmc2 Command Object.

methods.name: SlapBmc2ComoGetParamByIndex
methods.description: Fetches a parameter by its index from the Bmc2 Command Object.

methods.name: SlapBmc2ComoRemoveAllParams
methods.description: Removes all parameters from the Bmc2 Command Object.

methods.name: SlapBmc2ComoSetParamByIndex
methods.description: Sets the value of a parameter at the specified index.

methods.name: SlapBmc2ComoIsAborted
methods.description: Checks whether the Bmc2 Command Object operation has been aborted.
